question: Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. Statements: All polygons are angles. All angles are diagonals. All cones are cubes. All cubes are decagons. No diagonal is a cube. Conclusions: I. Some diagonals are polygons. II. All diagonals are decagons. III. No polygon is a cone. IV. Some cubes are angles.
options: Both conclusions II and IV follow
Both conclusions I and III follow
Both conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusion I follows
explanation: Polygons -> Angles -> Diagonals. Cones -> Cubes -> Decagons. No diagonal is a cube. Thus, some diagonals are polygons (I) and no polygon is a cone (III).

question: ‘A # B’ means ‘A is the son of B’. ‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’. ‘A & B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’. ‘A % B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’. If ‘M @ R % K # G # N & T’, then which of the following statements is NOT correct?
options: M is the mother of K.
R is the daughter of G.
T is the paternal grandfather of M.
N is the paternal grandmother of K.
explanation: M is the mother of R and K. G is the father of K. So, M is the wife of G. N is the parent of G, and N is the wife of T, making T the paternal grandfather of K and father-in-law of M, not the paternal grandfather of M.

explanation: S is the father of P, and T is the mother of S's brother R, making T the mother of S. Thus, T is the grandmother of P. Since P is male, P is the grandson of T.

options: Son-in-law

explanation: R is the father of S, and S is the son of T. So R and T are the parents of S. T is the daughter of N. Therefore, S is the son of T, making S the grandson of N.
